Segment Jordan Lee at CompassWorks using only these supplied facts: title Sales Director; owns forecasting, pipeline governance, and revenue systems across sales and marketing; has no frontline quota team and no direct reports. Do not enrich the lead.
evals.expected_output: A revenue-operations-leader classification based on responsibilities and scope rather than the Sales Director title.

Assigns exactly one bare root label, revenue-operations-leader.
Explicitly weighs responsibilities and cross-functional scope over title.
Cites persona language, applies the sales-director disqualifier, and names that losing alternative.
Uses the compact lead fields and never treats Jordan as the user or operator.
Does not enrich, ask a question, or change durable state.
Closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.
